BTCPay Server issues emergency update for 5 security flaws
The EU’s cybersecurity service said the flaws could let attackers to run malicious code remotely on vulnerable servers without logging in.
BTCPay Server issued an emergency update to fix five security flaws in Nginx, urging operators of its self-hosted Bitcoin payment software to install it as soon as possible.
The vulnerabilities affect Nginx, the software that routes incoming web traffic to BTCPay’s payment application. The developers behind the Bitcoin payment software said the update installs Nginx version 1.31.9.
According to a Wednesday advisory from the European Union’s cybersecurity response team, CERT-EU, the flaws could allow attackers to remotely run malicious code on vulnerable servers without logging in.
Researchers demonstrated how to exploit one vulnerability, but CERT-EU said no attacks involving any of the five flaws were reported as of Wednesday.
BTCPay said operators can install the fix through the maintenance settings or their Docker installation. Those using node platforms should update when their platforms make it available. The project also pointed operators unable to update immediately to a temporary workaround.
The emergency update follows two earlier BTCPay Server security incidents involving a separate vulnerability that attackers exploited to steal crypto.
In August, attackers exploited a flaw to obtain credentials for Lightning Network nodes and steal funds. In November, BTCPay reported Bitcoin and Litecoin hot-wallet thefts on outdated software, saying attackers had used a different method to exploit the August flaw.
Related: Binance hackers stole 192 tokens across 11 networks, court docs show

Cloudflare重做信息提取模型Clairic：从9B升级27B，新增PDF识别并开源

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Cloudflare 发布新版信息提取模型 Clairic，并推出轻量版 Clairic-flash。两款模型分别基于 Qwen3.8-27B 和 Qwen3.5-9B 开发，均已开源模型权重及推理代码，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证。

Clairic 此前于 10 月推出 9B 预览版，主要用于从文字、图片中提取金额、日期、订单号等数据，也能进行简单计算和预测。这次主模型升级至 27B，新增 PDF 识别，最多可同时处理 4 页 PDF 或图片，还能更准确地识别表格、清单等复杂内容。

Cloudflare 还重新设计了信息提取方式。旧版一次计算就给出结果，新版允许多个字段并行逐步生成答案，以少量速度损失换取更高准确率。

官方自测中，在包含文字和图片的合成收据测试里，旧版正确提取了 576 个字段中的 369 个，新版则全部答对。9B 的 Clairic-flash 在同一测试中也全部答对，处理普通文本字段的中位延迟约为 155 毫秒，27B 版则为 358 毫秒。

两款模型现已上线 Workers AI，12 月 1 日前均按每百万输入 Token 0.10 美元收费。此后 27B 版涨至 0.24 美元，9B 版维持 0.10 美元，均不收取输出 Token 费用。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/378177

items.content:
Bitcoin retests $62K as Nasdaq futures rise ahead of Anthropic debut
Bitcoin climbed back above $63,500 after its second dip to $62,000 this week, while Anthropic priced its record $81.3 billion IPO at $83 a share.
Bitcoin (BTC) rebounded from $62,000 on Thursday as US stock futures rose after Anthropic priced its record $81.3 billion IPO.
Key points:
- Bitcoin dropped to $62,000 late Wednesday before rebounding to $63,801 on Thursday.
- Anthropic priced the largest IPO on record at $83 a share, above its initial range of $70 to $78.
- On average, older Bitcoin moved at a lower price than when it last changed hands onchain.
Anthropic’s $81.3 billion IPO tops SpaceX’s record
BTC/USD fell to $62,000 shortly before Wednesday’s daily close, testing the level for the second time this week, TradingView data showed.
BTC/USD one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Anthropic priced 980 million shares at $83 each on Wednesday, above its initial range of $70 to $78. The $81.3 billion offering surpassed the $75 billion record SpaceX set in June. Anthropic shares are set to begin trading Thursday on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT.
Nasdaq 100 futures were up about 1.1% early Thursday. In Seoul, the Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) briefly reached 5,100.
KOSPI one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
“All of us have a sincere conviction that the AI exponential will generate so much value that, in the long run, it will far outweigh any shorter-term economic sacrifices we make as part of our mission,” Anthropic wrote in its founders’ letter.
Bitcoin onchain losses continue to mount
Bitcoin saw modest relief from sell-side pressure during the Asia trading session, returning to circle $63,500.
Related: Here’s what happened in crypto today
Wednesday saw net outflows of $306.5 million from the US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs), the largest single-day net outflow since Nov. 6, according to Farside Investors.
US spot Bitcoin ETF netflows (screenshot). Source: Farside Investors
Older coins were also moving at a loss, according to an analysis by XWIN Japan published on CryptoQuant.
The analysis tracked Bitcoin that had stayed put for more than 155 days. Over the seven days through Tuesday, those coins moved at prices about 6% lower, on average, than when they last moved.
Bitcoin LTH-SOPR chart. Source: CryptoQuant
Moving Bitcoin between an investor’s own wallets also counts as a transfer, so some of those coins may never have been sold.
Short-term holders also moved coins at a loss. Their ratio fell to 0.955 on Monday, its lowest since February, Cointelegraph previously reported.
items.title: Bitcoin retests $62K as Nasdaq futures rise ahead of Anthropic debut

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- Aave App added Tron USDT deposits as it opened Android early access, with availability varying by region.
- Aave lists Arbitrum for stablecoin withdrawals, and the Tron launch announcement covers deposits.
- The Stable Vault issues a dollar-denominated claim before paying an eligible token, subject to local liquidity and redemption limits.
Aave Labs added Tron USDT deposits to the Aave App on Nov. 17 as it opened early access on Android.
The new route lets eligible users fund the app’s savings vault with Tether’s stablecoin, and Aave lists Arbitrum as a withdrawal option.
Aave’s product page lists USDT, USDC and GHO alongside its Arbitrum withdrawal option. The rollout announced Tron as a funding network and left native Tron USDT payouts unconfirmed.
TRON DAO said eligible users in supported jurisdictions can make the deposits on both Android and iOS. New Android users can download the app and join a waitlist, or use a Ghost Pass to start sooner, according to Aave Labs’ launch announcement.
Under Aave’s app disclosures, a user sends a supported stablecoin from an external wallet to the address the app provides. Funds that reach the user’s self-custodial account enter the pooled Stable Vault under the user’s signed instructions.
The vault checks the deposit asset’s price, issues shares, and records the position in a unit nominally worth one US dollar.
The vault keeps its balance and withdrawal records on Arbitrum. Aave’s technical documentation identifies Ethereum mainnet as a chain where the vault can deploy funds to earn yield.
The pooled funds can move between approved strategies as deposits and withdrawals change the vault’s balances.
What turns a claim into a payout
The withdrawal request burns vault shares and creates a dollar-denominated claim, which Aave calls an IOU. Under the vault’s redemption rules, users can convert principal into that claim.
Converting accrued interest requires the vault to have enough assets, above what it already owes, to cover the interest being claimed.
Settlement burns the IOU and pays out a supported token. The vault needs enough of that token on the payout chain, and a system-wide limit controls how much users can redeem over a given period.
The redemption policy can also apply a fee that varies by asset. For example, a withdrawal in USDC depends on how much USDC is available on the redemption network, even if the saver originally funded the account with USDT.
A token payout goes to a wallet address the user has pre-authorized with a one-time code. Eligible users can separately withdraw to a linked bank account through a separate service that converts stablecoins to conventional currency.
Aave Labs says users can request withdrawals at any time without a lockup. The app’s disclosures say market stress, a shortage of available liquidity or problems with a bridge can delay settlement or make it temporarily unavailable. The rollout gave no settlement timetable for Tron-funded withdrawals.
The Aave DAO earns a fee from the gap between what the vault earns and what it credits to savers, but third-party charges may also apply. Network or swap costs can arise separately if the withdrawal involves converting one stablecoin into another.
In its Nov. 13 report, Aave Labs said user balances across the app had passed $45 million before the Tron rollout. DefiLlama’s Nov. 18 snapshot valued USDT on Tron at $91.7 billion, capturing the USDT supply on the funding network at that valuation.
Aave Labs advertised up to 7.25% annual yield in its launch post, subject to variable rates and eligibility. Aave’s separate Balance Protection program offers discretionary coverage for eligible users, subject to program limits.
Tether is +0.03% over the past 24 hours and currently sits at rank #3 by market cap.
items.title: Aave App taps $91B Tron liquidity as it opens Android early access

分析：BTC复刻上一轮熊市底部特征，MVRV Z-Score再次逼近零轴

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，分析师 Axel Adler Jr 指出，比特币的 MVRV Z-Score 在过去一周内从 0.66 大幅下降至 0.30。当该指标降至零时，意味着比特币的当前市值正好等于其已实现市值（即全市场平均持仓成本）。从历史数据来看，上一次该指标跌破零轴是在 2022 年 11 月至 2023 年 1 月期间，当时该指标在零轴下方连续停留了 68 天。

作为衡量资产估值偏离度的关键指标，MVRV Z-Score 逼近零轴表明，比特币的市场估值正在经历极度压缩，价格已极其接近甚至即将跌破全市场的平均持仓成本。在经历近期的持续下跌后，这一指标的快速回落暗示市场可能正在进入深度低估区域，复刻上一轮熊市底部的特征。

黄仁勋回不来了，英伟达临时CEO提前加薪发股票：700个员工提问，最关心的是钱

动察 Beating AI 快讯，11 月 18 日，英伟达临时 CEO Colette Kress 在黄仁勋辞职后的首次全员大会上，呼吁员工「向前看」，同时宣布将加薪和额外股票奖励提前至今年 12 月，比原定时间早了数月。

员工会前提交了约 700 个问题，其中薪酬问题最多，其次是要求董事会提高透明度。Kress 当场承诺，公司会照顾好每一位员工，让大家不必担心自己的薪酬待遇。

董事长 Harvey Jones 则再次明确，黄仁勋不会复职。他还首次在全员会上解释，董事会接受黄仁勋辞职，除了个人行为问题，还因为他「缺乏坦诚」。

Jones 表示，公司不可能找到「第二个黄仁勋」，但仍有具备技术能力、战略眼光和领导经验的人选。董事会不会为了尽快填补职位而降低标准，也欢迎员工推荐下一任 CEO 人选。

勒布朗·詹姆斯起诉Bron应用：AI广告虚假暗示其使用Kalshi

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，NBA 球星勒布朗·詹姆斯与 LBJ Trademarks LLC 已于 11 月 17 日向纽约南区联邦地区法院提起诉讼，被告为 AI 体育预测研究应用 Bron 的运营方 PlayVision 及其联合创始人 Anish Gupta、Marc Zoghby。诉状称，Gupta 于 11 月 4 日在 X 发布一则广告，使用带有詹姆斯体型、纹身和声音的 AI 生成形象，身穿印有「Bron」和 23 号的球衣，并以其声音说出「Dillon Brooks? On Kalshi? Hell nah」，画面中还出现 Kalshi 与 DraftKings 上的盈利标识。诉状称该广告约一天内在 X 获得约 100 万次观看，并虚假暗示詹姆斯使用与其独家合作伙伴 Polymarket 直接竞争的预测市场平台，同时暗示其参与预测 NBA 比赛，而这为联盟规则所禁止。

分析：比特币表观需求创年内新低，极度恐慌情绪暗藏逆向机会

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，CryptoQuant 分析师 Darkfost 指出，比特币的表观需求已降至 2026 年以来的最低水平，表明当前市场的兴趣甚至弱于今年 7 月的底部时期。该指标曾跌破-29 万枚 BTC，目前略有好转至-25.5 万枚 BTC，但仍远低于-17.2 万枚 BTC 的月度均值。这直观反映了当前的市场状态：投资者充满恐惧，并持续预期比特币将进一步下跌，即便该指标已触及极端水平。

分析师解释称，表观需求通过计算新 BTC 发行量与一年以上未移动供应量之间的差值，来衡量结构性买盘是否足以吸收网络产生的新抛压。值得注意的是，随着 8 月底以来全网算力增长超 13%，新供应正在增加，这需要更强劲的需求来承接。同时，短期持有者（STH）正承受沉重亏损。极端的负面情绪往往值得高度关注，当市场情绪跌至如此谷底时，采取逆向看多的视角或许能带来更丰厚的回报。

以太坊社区新草案提议动态合并激励：验证者数量高于目标时扣减余额

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，研究员 Anders Elowsson 向以太坊 EIPs 仓库提交一份草案，拟通过动态的「个人合并激励」，推动质押者将质押合并到更少的验证者。提案称，最终确定性成本随验证者数量而非质押总量上升，当前约有 81.5 万个验证者，平均有效余额仅约 54 ETH，已制约更快最终确定性。机制为每个纪元从验证者余额中扣减一笔费用，32 ETH 验证者最高可扣至其全部证明奖励，并随有效余额线性下降，至 2048 ETH 时为零。

验证者数量目标将在约 1.5 年内由起始值线性降至终端值后保持不变，示例分别为约 52.4 万和约 13.1 万。数量高于目标时，该费用按差距逐步上升，低于目标时以约 10 倍速度回落，若合并跟上日程则保持为零。该草案仍为 Draft，依赖已生效的 EIP-7251，激活参数尚未最终确定，编辑已建议编号为 EIP-8502。

谷歌世界模型Genie 4向Ultra用户开放：AI世界能边玩边改，还能分享给其他人

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Google DeepMind 将新一代世界模型 Genie 4 接入 Project Genie，开始向符合条件的 Google AI Ultra 订阅用户开放。Project Genie 是谷歌今年 1 月推出的网页应用，用户可以通过文字或图片创建虚拟世界，再用键盘控制角色，在 AI 实时生成的场景中自由探索。

Genie 4 加入了原生音频，能随着画面变化实时生成环境声、音乐和人物对话。用户还可以在探索过程中输入文字，随时改变天气、添加角色或触发事件，让虚拟世界按照自己的想法不断变化。

Project Genie 还新增了 AI 创作助手。之前用户需要自己描述场景、调整初始画面和视角，现在可以直接通过聊天设计世界，让 AI 自动生成初始场景和配乐。进入世界后，Gemini 还能持续观察画面，推荐下一步探索方向，甚至自动触发场景中的事件。

上一代 Genie 3 也获得升级，单次探索时长从 60 秒延长至 3 分钟，还能把多个虚拟世界连接起来，连续探索不同场景。用户也可以上传 360 度全景照片，让 AI 根据真实环境生成可探索的空间。

Project Genie 同时新增社区作品库，用户可以分享自己创建的世界，其他人可以直接进入探索，也能修改场景、音乐和规则，制作自己的版本。

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- Invesco’s IROXX fund records shares on Ethereum and initially targets institutions, including stablecoin issuers.
- Superstate normally sends same-day dollar wires for valid fund business-day requests received before the cutoff.
- Shareholders can choose USDC proceeds through a third party that sets its own conversion and delivery terms.
Invesco announced a government money market fund on Nov. 17 that gives eligible institutions a way to hold part of their stablecoin reserves in fund shares recorded on Ethereum.
If a stablecoin issuer needs dollars from the fund to pay customers, it has to redeem those shares on the fund’s business-day schedule.
The Invesco Stablecoin Reserves Onchain Fund (IROXX) is initially aimed at institutions such as stablecoin issuers and digital asset infrastructure providers. Its shares represent an investment in short-duration US Treasury securities and other eligible reserve assets. Holding a stablecoin alone gives a customer no right to redeem shares in the fund.
Investors in supported jurisdictions need an approved Superstate account and a verified wallet on the allowlist to hold IROXX on the Ethereum network.
The standard initial minimum is $1 million per fund account, and Invesco or an intermediary can combine master accounts and subaccounts to meet it.
When the stablecoin wire goes out
To redeem, shareholders submit a request through the Investor Portal run by Superstate, the fund’s sub-transfer agent.
Under the fund’s redemption terms, Superstate normally sends a dollar wire on the next business day if it receives a valid request before 5 p.m. Eastern. For a request received after the cutoff on a business day, the fund normally prices the redemption and sends the wire on the next business day.
The price is the next net asset value per share calculated after Superstate receives the request in good order. The ordinary payment terms allow up to seven days after Superstate receives a request in good order.
Early closes can affect same-day payment, and the fund can also withhold same-day payment in the 30 minutes before it calculates the share price.
A fund business day depends on the New York Fed, the fund’s custodian, and its main portfolio markets being open. Management also has to judge that the market can handle purchase and redemption requests.
Shareholders pay blockchain transaction fees, known as gas, on redemptions. Congestion or insufficient gas can delay a request past the cutoff even if the shareholder starts the transaction before it.
Investors can also elect USDC proceeds through a third-party intermediary, with the service setting its own onboarding and conversion terms, including when it delivers the tokens. The fund’s normal wire schedule gives investors a timetable for when dollars are sent, while USDC delivery depends on the intermediary.
That leaves a gap for a stablecoin issuer drawing on IROXX to plan for if customers seek dollars after the fund’s cutoff. Paying them before the next wire goes out depends on the liquidity the issuer already has available.
items.title: Invesco moves stablecoin reserves on-chain, but hides a liquidity gap

Sygnum：预计比特币套利交易2027年平均回报将超过美国国债收益率

2026 年，比特币 30 日平均资金费率曾连续 67 天处于负值，直至 5 月才结束这一阶段。Sygnum 报告显示，CME 比特币期货年化基差在 8 月降至约 3%，低于美国两年期国债 3.8% 的收益率；截至 10 月底，比特币资金费率已恢复至约 8% 的年化水平。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi
items.content:
Bitcoin carry trades could beat Treasury bills in 2027, Sygnum predicts
Sygnum predicts that Bitcoin carry trades may offer higher returns than Treasury bills in 2027, following a sharp drop in funding rates that made the strategy less compelling in 2026.
Bitcoin carry trades could regain their edge over US Treasury bills in 2027 as demand for leverage recovers, according to digital asset bank Sygnum.
In its 2027 Sygnal Outlook report, Sygnum forecasts that the annualized premium on three-month Bitcoin (BTC) futures at the Chicago Mercantile Exchange would average more than 2% above three-month US Treasury bill yields next year.
A crypto carry trade involves buying Bitcoin while betting against its price through futures contracts. This helps limit exposure to Bitcoin’s price swings while also allowing traders to collect funding payments or futures premiums.
Fabian Dori, chief investment officer at Sygnum, told Cointelegraph that returns could recover as investors become more willing to take risks and fewer hedge funds compete for the same profits.
“The basis trade had become very crowded, with many hedge funds running it through spot ETFs [exchange-traded funds] against short CME futures,” Dori said. “Positioning data indicates that those funds have now unwound much of their CME short positions, so there is less capital competing for the same premium.”
Why Bitcoin carry returns fell
Sygnum cited a 67-day stretch of negative Bitcoin funding rates in 2026. It also comes as crypto tech and infrastructure company Talos recently published research showing how much returns have fallen.
In its latest report, Talos said Bitcoin funding rates and futures premiums, which reached peak annualized levels of 20%-40% in early 2024, dropped to just 3%-5% this year. The current three-month US Treasury bill yield is around 4.25%, which means traders can earn about the same return from government debt without taking on the extra risks of crypto trading.
Bitcoin perpetual funding rates and the 30-day futures basis, annualized, 2024-2026. Source: Talos CM Market Data Pro
Sygnum’s forecast now raises the question of whether Bitcoin carry trades can make enough money to justify the risks, such as sudden drops in returns and higher trading costs. And while returns have started to improve, it’s unclear whether that will continue into 2027.
Bitcoin carry trades became popular after the launch of US spot Bitcoin ETFs in 2024, which gave larger investors an easier way to use the strategy. But as more investors entered the market, the returns available from these trades began to fall.
“A more mature market pays less for the same trade,” Dori said. “But it also attracts additional investors, which may increase the demand for leverage.”
According to Talos, Bitcoin funding rates turned negative briefly in the second quarter of the year. This meant that traders betting against Bitcoin through perpetual futures had to pay traders betting on higher prices — as opposed to collecting payments.
Related: Bitcoin ETF inflows leave institutional demand unclear: CoinShares
Bitcoin funding shows tentative recovery
Still, there have been signs of a recovery: Talos found that crypto funding rates have started to rise again since August, potentially supporting Sygnum’s prediction. Coinbase also said in a Nov. 2 report that Bitcoin funding rates rose from around 4% annualized at the start of October to an average of 8.9% annualized in the last week of the month.
Coinbase questioned whether the increase reflected meaningful demand for leveraged Bitcoin trades; it cited weaker buying activity in the spot market.
“It’s less clear to us that the late rise in BTC leverage reflects conviction, given how little support it had from spot holders or the options market,” Coinbase’s report reads.
Sygnum expects wider institutional adoption to support demand for leveraged Bitcoin exposure in 2027. It pointed to factors such as growing institutional investment in Bitcoin, the growth of tokenization and rising demand for AI.
However, Dori warned that a sharp market downturn, a shortage of liquidity, or interest rates staying higher for longer could prevent carry trade returns from recovering. He also pointed to risks that come with increased leveraged trading. Even a hedged position can face margin calls, requiring traders to post more collateral or close their futures position.
“Carry can pay steadily for long periods and then turn quickly,” he said. “When positioning gets crowded and funding reverses, the unwind is typically fast, because the same leverage that pays the carry forces the exit.”
Magazine: Why US-regulated Bitcoin perpetuals could change crypto trading
items.title: Bitcoin carry trades could beat Treasury bills in 2027, Sygnum predicts

以太坊sBOLD金库遭340万美元攻击，区块构建者获得约178万美元费用

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，K3 Capital 旗下 sBOLD 储蓄金库周三遭攻击，攻击者通过操纵金库份额核算方式，在约 8 分钟内转移约 340 万美元资产。Bitquery 追踪了清空金库的 97 笔交易，数据显示，参与抢跑攻击交易的机器人向以太坊区块构建者支付约 178 万美元。

攻击者通过反复存入 BOLD、引入最初未纳入金库核算的封装 ETH，再将其兑换为 BOLD，以虚高的份额价值赎回资产。该操作可在单笔交易中重复执行，从而提取其他存款人的资金。其中，一个自动交易机器人复制攻击过程，提取约 191 万美元，占被盗资金的 56%，但为抢在竞争对手之前打包交易，向区块构建者支付了大部分收益。Titan 构建了包含该机器人交易的大部分区块，BuilderNet、Ultrasound 和 Quasar 也参与处理。

178 万美元属于区块构建者收到的付款，并非已确认利润，因为构建者还需向验证者支付费用。原始攻击者及其资助的钱包最终合计获得约 52 万美元。ChainSecurity 曾于 2025 年 5 月审计 sBOLD，并指出一种可通过自我清算提取价值的方式，但目前尚不清楚此次攻击是否利用了相关机制。

items.content:
Senators warn GENIUS Act rules could push stablecoin firms toward federal oversight
The lawmakers urged Treasury to extend safe harbor protections to stablecoin issuers in states expected to establish qualifying regulatory frameworks before January 2028.
Six bipartisan senators on Tuesday urged the US Treasury Department to extend proposed regulatory protections to state-supervised stablecoin issuers, warning that proposed GENIUS Act rules could steer firms toward federal licenses.
In a letter to Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, Senators Cynthia Lummis and Kirsten Gillibrand, along with Angela Alsobrooks, Kevin Cramer, Pete Ricketts and Mark Warner, said Treasury’s proposal offers a safe harbor to certain issuers with pending federal applications and regulator-approved waivers, but no equivalent protection for state issuers.
The senators warned that issuers “may be incentivized to seek greater operational clarity under a federal license,” including through the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), which they said was “the opposite of our intent in drafting this legislation.”
The senators urged Treasury to extend the safe harbor to issuers in states expected to have qualifying frameworks in place before Jan. 18, 2028, reducing uncertainty while certification reviews are pending.
The senators’ request follows a June appeal, urging Treasury to preserve state participation and clarify the certification process.
The GENIUS Act generally allows issuers with $10 billion or less in outstanding stablecoins to operate under qualifying state supervision, with exemptions available above that threshold.
Kevin Wysocki, head of policy at Anchorage Digital, questioned whether a broader safe harbor would make much difference. He said issuers are choosing federal oversight because they risk having to switch regulators if their stablecoins exceed $10 billion in circulation, although exemptions are available.
Related: Treasury Secretary Bessent likens GENIUS Act to Lincoln-era banking reform
items.title: Senators warn GENIUS Act rules could push stablecoin firms toward federal oversight

三名前OpenAI研究员创业18个月，靠企业定制AI拿下45亿美元收购协议

动察 Beating AI 快讯，网络安全巨头 Palo Alto Networks 宣布，拟以 45 亿美元全股票收购 AI 初创公司 Applied Compute。这家公司 11 月 2 日刚完成 3.5 亿美元融资，估值达到 32.5 亿美元。

Applied Compute 由 3 名前 OpenAI 研究人员创立，成立仅约 18 个月，目前约有 70 名员工。公司称，年化营收运行率已达到约 1 亿美元。

Applied Compute 专门帮企业训练自己的 AI 模型。它以开放权重模型为基础，用企业的业务数据进一步训练，再负责部署和持续改进。例如，它为法律 AI 公司 Harvey 定制的模型，在提高回答和引用质量的同时，将推理成本降到了某款前沿模型的一半以下。它还为 Clay 训练了模型路由系统，最高降低 47% 的推理成本。

Palo Alto Networks 原本主要提供网络安全产品，如今准备进一步涉足企业 AI 模型的训练与运行，让客户既能使用自己的专属模型，也能获得配套的安全防护。Applied Compute 创始人 Yash Patil 将在交易完成后担任联合首席 AI 官。

根据收购方披露，45 亿美元交易对价中包含约 5 亿美元的现金及预付算力承诺。交易仍需监管审批，预计于 2027 年 2 月至 4 月完成。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Binance hackers stole 192 tokens across 11 networks, court docs show
Stablecoins accounted for at least $3.46 billion of the $6.3 billion stolen, while the hackers also took memecoins, tokenized gold and gaming tokens.
Hackers behind the record $6.3 billion Binance hack stole a total of 192 cryptocurrencies across 11 blockchain networks, new court documents reveal.
The figures come from an asset schedule submitted by Nest Clearing and Custody Limited, which operated the affected Binance wallets, and included in a Wednesday Abu Dhabi court order shared with Cointelegraph.
Tether’s USDt (USDT) accounted for the largest share of stolen value at $2.50 billion, followed by $1.42 billion in Bitcoin (BTC) and $826 million in Circle’s USDC (USDC). Together, the three assets made up about 76% of the total value of misappropriated tokens.
While earlier reports identified many of the tokens stolen in the attack, the latest court documents show a full breakdown of all crypto assets stolen in the attack, including the quantities and what they were worth at the time of the theft.
Cointelegraph’s analysis found that fiat-linked stablecoins accounted for at least $3.46 billion, 55% of the assets stolen. Beyond USDt and USDC, the court schedule lists nine other fiat-linked stablecoins.
These included Ripple USD (RLUSD), World Liberty Financial USD (USD1), Ethena USDe (USDE), First Digital USD (FDUSD), Sky Dollar (USDS), StraitsX USD (XUSD), Binance USD (BUSD), Pax Dollar (USDP) and Eurite (EURI). The nine stablecoins were worth $132.4 million combined at the time of the theft.
Stolen memecoins, gold-backed tokens
The Binance hackers also stole $37.9 million in memecoins, led by $34.9 million in Pepe (PEPE) and $2.3 million in Shiba Inu (SHIB).
Another $58 million in tokenized gold and more than $5 million across five gaming and metaverse tokens, including The Sandbox (SAND), Axie Infinity (AXS) and Decentraland (MANA), were stolen in the hack. Around $73.5 million of Wrapped Beacon ETH (WBETH) was stolen.
The haul also included $97.4 million across three DeFi tokens, led by $45.1 million in Uniswap’s UNI, followed by $37.3 million in Ethena’s ENA and $15.1 million in Aave’s AAVE.
Meanwhile, Ethereum accounted for roughly 60% of the stolen assets by value, more than any other blockchain network.
Related: Binance hack may push institutions to outside custody, FalconX exec says
Abu Dhabi court to hear bid for frozen assets on Dec. 1
Cointelegraph previously reported that the Abu Dhabi Global Market Courts issued a $6.5 billion worldwide freezing injunction against the unidentified people accused of carrying out the attack.
The order restricts them from dealing with assets up to that value and requires them to disclose worldwide assets worth more than $50,000 in sworn statements by Nov. 30.
A separate order requires 18 named firms, including Circle and BitGo Bank & Trust, to maintain existing freezes on assets linked to the hack.
Court documents show it will consider on Dec. 1 whether to extend that injunction and whether the firms must hand over the assets they froze.
The US Department of Justice said last Thursday it had obtained court authorization to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of the $6.3 billion in cryptocurrency stolen from Binance.
The authorization covers part of the more than $2.7 billion in stolen assets that US authorities and private-sector partners have frozen since the Oct. 29 hack. Investigators are still working to recover additional funds.
Magazine: How to preserve wealth and access funds during a national emergency
items.title: Binance hackers stole 192 tokens across 11 networks, court docs show

items.author: jdns
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[cowlevel]: So the recent RCE wave seems to be people finding more single byte overflows and such, but reporting them as RCEs because AI can do the tedious grunt work of finding the rest of the vulnerability chain. If any single byte overflow can be converted into an RCE with minimal human effort then we have no choice but to prove the whole software stack is memory safe.

[circularfoyers]: Thought this was another vulnerability for a second, but for anyone else who thought the same, this is already covered in the Ruby advisory being discussed here  https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50554038  (which covers six other vulnerabilities).

[djha-skin]: I remember being a kid in a small town. My dad got into an auto accident, and the next day the DJs talked about it on the radio. Then we moved to the Chicago area and the morning news only ever talked about  how many  accidents we'd see  that day  on our theoretical morning commute during the traffic segment. At what point will we stop considering individual x2shell ultra-critical CVEs news in the age of AI? Like, how many of these are we finding  per hour ?

[barbegal]: More interested to see how you can use just a single byte overflow to trigger RCE. Definitely achievable but sounds tough.

[t1234s]: For people who haven't been to Germany the character that looks like a script B is pronounced like "S". Its a bit of humor in what is an annoying problem.

Bitunix分析师：AI资本狂热与美债资金分化，市场反弹恐延长紧缩周期

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，Anthropic 上市将 AI 投资热度推向公开市场，散户首日净买入预估达 2.5 亿美元，IPO 定价 83 美元，高于指导区间，反映市场对 AI 龙头仍有强烈追价意愿。然而，公司九个月营收超过 330 亿美元，同比增长 1200%，同时累计支出承诺高达 9000 亿美元，增长与资本需求同步扩张。庞大的融资与基建成本将成为估值能否延续的关键，上市热度并不意味着资金风险消失。

与 AI 资金追逐形成对比，9 月海外美债持仓减少 755 亿美元，降至 9.24 万亿美元的一年低点，日本、英国及中国均有减持，但韩国逆势买入 115 亿美元，创历史纪录，显示全球资金并非一致撤离美元资产，而是在重新调整配置。当美债收益率高企、通胀与财政风险仍未消退，资金流向更反映不同市场对利率与经济前景的判断。

德银指出，中东能源风险、AI 投资降温与欧洲债务压力未必同步恶化，AI 资本支出减少甚至可能降低能源需求、通胀与债券融资压力；但若油价上涨，则可能同时推高通胀、压低增长。更值得注意的是，股市反弹、信用利差收窄将放松金融条件，反而可能让美联储更有理由维持紧缩。对 BTC 及风险资产而言，市场真正需要的不是短暂反弹，而是通胀降温与资金成本下降能否同步发生。

英伟达Blackwell贡献74%的新增AI推理容量，GB300单卡是H100的25倍

动察 Beating AI 快讯，研究机构 Epoch AI 最新估算，英伟达 Blackwell 系列芯片贡献了过去一年全球新增 AI Agent 请求处理能力的 74%。其中，GB300 单卡在特定测试条件下，能够同时处理的 Agent 请求量约为 H100 的 25 倍、H200 的 8 倍。

编程 Agent 需要反复读取代码、保留历史对话、调用工具。芯片除了要进行计算，还要用显存保存大量上下文，并快速读取数据。显存容量、读写带宽，以及多块芯片之间的通信速度，都会影响能同时运行多少个 Agent。

按照传统的每秒计算次数衡量，GB300 的峰值算力仅为 H100 的约 2.5 倍。但综合这些因素后，Epoch AI 估算其 Agent 请求处理能力达到约 25 倍。

从 2025 年第二季度到 2026 年第二季度，全球累计售出 AI 芯片能够同时处理的 Agent 请求量增至原来的 4.6 倍，而同期峰值算力只增至 2.6 倍。

英伟达临时 CEO Colette Kress 在 11 月 17 日的财报电话会上确认，公司已停止向中国出货获许可的 Hopper 系列数据中心芯片，包括 H200。华为则计划在 2027 年第一季度推出昇腾 960DT，公布的 FP8 峰值算力规格接近 H200。

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- Binance listed IBITUSDT on Nov. 18 with round-the-clock trading and a launch leverage ceiling of 20x.
- When vendor quotes are unavailable on weekends and holidays, the futures order book supplies the index inputs.
- Binance uses its mark price to trigger liquidation, and that price can move while the ETF market is closed.
Binance Futures added a perpetual contract tied to BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (IBIT) on Nov. 18.
The contract (IBITUSDT) gives eligible traders round-the-clock exposure to the Nasdaq-listed fund, settles in Tether’s USDT, and offered up to 20x leverage at launch.
Binance set the opening for 09:45 UTC in a listing notice, and the exchange’s public futures ticker recorded trades after the scheduled opening. The contract keeps trading after the fund’s market closes, and Binance’s mark price can still move far enough to trigger liquidation.
Traders can take a position on IBIT's rise or fall without owning its shares or Bitcoin, as the fund seeks to reflect Bitcoin's price.
Binance’s TradFi FAQ lists the UK, Hong Kong, Taiwan and some European Economic Area countries as common examples of restricted markets for these products. The 20x figure is the launch ceiling, and Binance’s margin rules set lower leverage ceilings for larger positions.
How Binance prices IBIT exposure after hours
The price index is Binance’s reference for the underlying and helps feed the mark price, the estimate the exchange uses to determine whether a position has reached its liquidation threshold.
During regular equity trading, Binance builds its reference index from third-party price quotes. It smooths those quotes during premarket and after-hours trading, then gives new quotes less weight during the overnight session, according to Binance’s pricing methodology.
On weekends, holidays, and during covered maintenance periods without those quotes, Binance looks to the futures order book, where traders place buy and sell orders for the perpetual.
It averages two measures from that book, the impact bid and impact ask, then smooths the result by giving more weight to recent readings. The index can keep moving while the ETF’s last share price stays where trading left it.
The index feeds the mark, which Binance calculates separately from the latest executed trade.
If an adverse move leaves too little collateral to keep the position open, Binance can forcibly close it while the ETF market is shut. Under Binance’s liquidation rules, the mark triggers that process when it reaches the position’s liquidation threshold.
Binance normally limits the weekend and holiday gap between the mark and the index to 3% in either direction for equity-linked perpetuals and can adjust the limit in extreme conditions.
A trader can be right about where IBIT shares will reopen and still be forced out of the perpetual over the weekend if Binance’s mark crosses the liquidation level first.

新加坡发行1亿新元代币化票据，拟建立统一身份验证协议监管AI代理金融风险

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，据彭博社报道，新加坡金融管理局（MAS）局长 Chia Der Jiun 表示，AI 代理可能以更快速度转移资金和配置资产，即使激励金额较小，也可能引发新的流动性及金融稳定风险，金融机构可能需要对 AI 代理发起的交易设置限额，监管机构也需评估其对金融稳定的影响。

Chia Der Jiun 同时警告，不应向个人 AI 代理提供金融账户登录凭证，目前尚无法充分确保其安全性。新加坡金管局计划制定统一的「了解你的代理」（Know Your Agent）协议，供银行和支付服务商核实 AI 代理的身份、权限及授权范围，并将测试利用 AI 代理监控流动性头寸，以及通过代币化存款或稳定币执行支付。

此外，新加坡金管局本月已发行 1 亿新元（约 7800 万美元）的代币化票据（MAS Bills），并使用新加坡元央行数字货币完成结算，未来将与行业合作将更多常用抵押品引入数字平台，包括外国政府证券和货币市场基金。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/378127

华尔街承诺为英伟达动员5000亿美元融资，至今尚未投放一分钱

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，今年 8 月，英伟达联合 Apollo、Blackstone、BlackRock、Brookfield、Goldman Sachs 和 KKR 等华尔街巨头，宣布计划动员 5000 亿美元，为 OpenAI、Anthropic 等 AI 企业及其他芯片客户提供融资支持，但截至目前，该计划尚未实际投入任何资金。

报道称，英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋最初希望与华尔街合作推出规模达 1 万亿美元的融资计划，以帮助信用资质较弱的 AI 初创公司购买英伟达芯片，维持未来芯片销售增长。但各方签署的合作备忘录仅有数页，主要明确融资目标、潜在客户范围，以及英伟达将视具体项目提供信用担保的原则，参与机构并未承诺实际募集资金，5000 亿美元也并非具有约束力的融资承诺。

融资计划迟迟未能落地的关键障碍在于风险分担。英伟达此前表示，愿意提供的信用支持最高不超过项目成本的 25%，而华尔街投资者希望获得更高比例的担保。与此同时，随着信贷市场对 AI 企业偿债能力日益谨慎，金融机构也开始收紧相关融资。

目前，各方仍在讨论首笔以英伟达芯片为抵押的客户融资交易，但预计最快也要到明年才能完成。英伟达临时 CEO、财务主管 Colette Kress 周二表示，公司正在严格评估未来投资、承诺及担保，将更加审慎地参与相关交易。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/378121

items.content:
美国拟强制企业公开「用了中国AI」：Airbnb、Cursor已被国会盯上

动察 Beating AI 快讯，特朗普政府正在考虑要求美国企业公开披露使用中国 AI 模型的情况。企业可能需要直接在官网说明自己用了哪些中国模型。

消息人士透露，美国财政部和白宫科技政策办公室已经讨论这一方案。他们不直接禁止企业使用中国 AI，而是通过公开披露带来的声誉和政治压力，劝退美国企业。

有不少知名公司已经被盯上。Airbnb 使用阿里 Qwen 支持 AI 客服，Cursor 的编程模型 Composer 2 基于月之暗面 Kimi K2.5 继续训练，DoorDash 也将部分内部任务交给 Kimi 处理。今年 4 月以来，美国国会已先后向这三家公司发函调查。

美国国会下属的美中经济与安全审查委员会本月还提出了更严格的建议：企业使用中国 AI 必须公开说明，未披露可能面临监管处罚，上市公司还要向 SEC 报告相关风险。委员会甚至建议，未经安全评估和授权，禁止在关键基础设施、国家安全等敏感领域部署中国模型。

中国开源模型正在美国企业中快速普及，主要原因是价格更低、性能足够好，而且方便企业自行修改。Airbnb 回应称，其绝大多数 AI 业务仍使用美国模型，少量中国模型也只通过获批准的美国服务商运行，以隔离和保护数据。

目前，这项披露要求仍处于讨论阶段，尚未成为正式规定。委员会的更严格建议也没有获得立法通过。

谷歌Neon拿下编程Agent世界第一：击败Fable 5.2，任务成本还更低

动察 Beating AI 快讯，谷歌Neon拿下编程Agent世界第一：击败Fable 5.2，任务成本还更低

谷歌刚发布的 Gemini 4 Neon，拿下了 Artificial Analysis 编程智能体（Coding Agent）排行榜第一名，超过了 11 月 9 日才发布的 Claude Fable 5.2。

Neon 搭配 Antigravity CLI，在最高推理档位下取得 58.6 分（榜单四舍五入显示为 59 分），领先搭配 Claude Code 的 Fable 5.2 和 Opus 5.5，后两者均为约 58 分。

这项综合评测包含 FrontierCode-AA 2.0、Terminal-Bench 4.1 和 SWE-Atlas-QnA-AA 三项测试，各占总成绩的三分之一。由于测试的是模型与 Agent 工具的组合，排名也会受到工具本身的影响。

Artificial Analysis 按 API 用量估算，Neon 完成一项编程任务平均花费 6.86 美元，Fable 5.2 为 15.47 美元，Opus 5.5 为 12.61 美元。

另外在 CursorBench 4.1 测试中，Neon 甚至不用开最高推理档，就以 63.7% 的得分超过了 Fable 5.2 最高档的 61.3%，平均每项任务成本仅 6.54 美元，后者却要 48.11 美元。即使把 Neon 也开到最高档，得分进一步升至 65.4%，任务成本也只有 10.67 美元，不到 Fable 5.2 的四分之一。

Gemini 4 Neon 刷新了编程模型的性能与成本「帕累托前沿」。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/378111

Skydance CEO证实马斯克已入股公司，称获得其投资是荣幸

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，据 Variety 报道，传媒娱乐巨头 Skydance 董事长兼 CEO David Ellison 在周三举行的《纽约时报》2026 DealBook 峰会上证实，马斯克已成为 Skydance 股东，但未披露具体投资金额。此前 CNBC 和 Semafor 报道称，马斯克在 Skydance 与派拉蒙、华纳兄弟探索合并后投资约 10 亿美元。

David Ellison 表示，马斯克是这个时代最伟大的企业家之一，其投资代表了对公司的信任，能够拥有马斯克这样的股东是公司的荣幸。如果未来存在合适的合作机会，公司也将非常乐意与其合作，但目前尚无具体合作计划。

此次表态也引发外界对 Skydance 与马斯克旗下 SpaceX 及 Starlink 未来合作的猜测。David Ellison 同时确认，Skydance 仍计划于 2027 年第一季度在 HBO Max 上线马斯克纪录片《Musk》。

Skydance 于今年 10 月 6 日完成与华纳兄弟探索的 1110 亿美元合并交易，合并后公司净债务约 800 亿美元，并计划到 2029 年实现每年 60 亿美元的成本协同效应。

「AI股神」Leopold计划重启基金，拟重新使用杠杆并寻求外部融资

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，据英国《金融时报》报道，25 岁的 AI 投资人、Situational Awareness 创始人 Leopold Aschenbrenner 正计划在基金经历近乎致命的亏损事件仅四个月后重启业务，新计划被称为「Situational Awareness 2.0」。据知情人士透露，Aschenbrenner 近期已与投资者及主经纪商讨论重新开展杠杆交易，并计划于明年初寻求外部融资。

今年夏季，Situational Awareness 因押注 AI 股票遭遇巨额亏损，管理资产规模曾超过 200 亿美元，随后在数日内被迫与 Citadel 达成紧急协议，以折价出售绝大部分公开市场持仓，并偿还高盛、摩根大通等贷款方。目前基金仍管理超过 100 亿美元资产，主要为私人投资，其中持有约 50 亿美元 Anthropic 股份。

报道称，Aschenbrenner 此前曾与 Jefferies 洽谈开设主经纪账户，但该银行今年早些时候因认为基金对冲不足而拒绝合作。基金目前还与专业经纪商 Clear Street 合作，并正在寻找首席风险官。目前团队约有 30 名员工。

此次重启计划恰逢 Anthropic 筹备 IPO。Situational Awareness 持有的 Anthropic 股份预计将在上市后大幅升值。不过，重新使用杠杆及引入外部资金的计划尚未最终敲定。此前 Aschenbrenner 曾在 7 月向投资者承认管理失误，并表示基金已停止通过银行借贷放大投资头寸。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/378107

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- Testnet5 enforces four proposed Bitcoin rules from block one, giving mining pools a way to test their block-building software.
- The minimum difficulty rises from 1 on Testnet4 to roughly 1 million on Testnet5 to curb rapid early mining.
- Bitcoin Core and Sparrow Wallet still have open Testnet5 proposals, with early node sync and wallet tests already reported.
Bitcoin miners have a new network, Testnet5, where they can test their software against four proposed changes to Bitcoin’s rules, with support in Bitcoin Core and Sparrow Wallet at the patch stage.
The Bitcoin Improvement Proposals repository added the record of Testnet5’s first block to the network specification on Nov. 17, three days after the block was mined.
What Bitcoin miners can test
The four changes are collectively known as BIP54, or Consensus Cleanup. Bitcoin Inquisition’s signet already enforces them, but producing blocks there also requires miners to satisfy a signing challenge in addition to proof of work.
On Testnet5, independent miners and pools can use their own software to build blocks and see whether other nodes accept them without that extra requirement.
Two of the four rules limit how much work certain blocks can impose on nodes and how miners can use timestamps to influence difficulty. One caps certain signature operations in ordinary transactions to limit how long a block can take to verify.
The other restricts timestamps at the start and end of each difficulty period to prevent miners from artificially driving the difficulty down.
A third rule rejects transactions that measure exactly 64 bytes after removing witness data, closing an ambiguity in proofs of transaction inclusion. The fourth makes each new mining reward transaction unique by requiring its locktime to equal the block height minus one and requiring that locktime to take effect.
Pool operators can use Testnet5 to check that their software, which usually builds the reward transaction, applies the new rule.
Testnet4 let miners drop to minimum difficulty if a block’s timestamp was more than 20 minutes after the previous one, except at the start of a difficulty period. BIP95 says competing blocks mined under the exception caused frequent short reorganizations, where one set of recent blocks replaced another.
Testnet5 removes the 20-minute rule altogether and raises the minimum difficulty from 1 to about 1 million. The specification’s authors chose the higher floor to slow early block production before difficulty adjusts, while keeping it low enough for a single specialized mining machine to keep the test chain running.
Early testers can build the Bitcoin Core patch and sync by manually connecting to a peer, its author reported. The proposal targets Core’s 32.x branch and still needs to be merged and shipped in a public release.
Bitcoin Core 32.1, the latest release as of Nov. 18, predates the Testnet5 integration build.
Sparrow’s wallet integration proposal opened late on Nov. 17, and would let users select Testnet5 in the wallet and add two public Electrum servers to connect to the chain.
A Sparrow collaborator reported on Nov. 18 that the wallet’s Silent Payments feature worked in tests against both servers. The proposal, which depends on an update to Sparrow’s Drongo library, remained open.
items.title: Bitcoin launches Testnet5 and gives miners a real trial of four proposed fixes

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，《Grand Theft Auto VI》（GTA 6）在全球正式发售上线，登陆 PlayStation 5 与 Xbox Series X|S 平台。

发售前夕，市场研究机构 Sensor Tower 估算的预售数据引发广泛关注，最新数据显示该游戏预售接近或超过 1700 万份、收入约 16.5 亿美元。其中 PS5 占比约 75%，Xbox 约占 25%。Take-Two Interactive（Rockstar 母公司）未公布官方具体数字，但在财报中表示预售「远超内部预期」。

与此同时，英国职场也因游戏发售出现明显波动。HR 软件公司 BrightHR 分析其覆盖超过 120 万员工、7 万家英国企业的缺勤数据并外推后指出，11 月与 12 月因 GTA 6 相关原因预订的年假约达 8.3 万天，预计给企业造成约 1240 万英镑成本（按每天约 150 英镑计算）。仅发售当天（11 月 19 日），相关年假成本约 314 万英镑，当天请假原因中约 4.63% 提到 GTA，请求量甚至超过蜜月等传统事由。部分员工在请假理由中直接写明「为 GTA 6 请假，拒绝就辞职」。

据 GMGN 数据显示，GTA6 相关 Meme 币 DacityCoin（DCTY）24 小时拉涨 38,100%，市值现报 1364 万美元，24 小时交易额达 6500 万美元。

据悉，Dacity Coin（DACITY）是一个基于 Solana 的 meme 币，其来源是在 GTA 6 此前的泄露画面中，出现了「AudaCity」品牌和相关特技任务（女主 Lucia 跳伞做宣传）。从网络流露出的游戏实机演示视频信息显示，GTA6 确实在游戏内部存在 DacityCoin（DCTY）相关游戏内容，但本意或仅是对荒诞 Meme 币炒作的写实映射。

BlockBeats 注：Meme 币交易波动巨大，多依赖市场情绪和概念的炒作，并无实际价值或用例，投资者需注意风险。

标普维持USDT锚定美元能力最低评级，高风险资产占比升至28%，Tether援引《大空头》反驳

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，据 Cointelegraph 报道，标普全球评级（S&P Global Ratings）在最新稳定币稳定性评估中，将 Tether 发行的 USDT 维持美元挂钩能力的评分维持在最低档 5（弱），与 2025 年 11 月的评估结果相同。标普表示，截至 9 月 30 日，黄金、比特币、公开市场股票、担保贷款和公司债券等较高风险持仓相当于流通中 USDT 的 28%，高于一年前的 24%；「这些资产价值若大幅下跌，可能导致 USDT 抵押不足」。标普还称发现了更多薄弱点，但「评估不能低于 5」，因此未再下调。

Tether 向 Cointelegraph 回应称，「问题在于标普的框架，而不是我们的储备」，并提及电影《大空头》及 2008 年金融危机，称「他们自己的历史就能说明根本问题」。Tether 经 BDO 鉴证的 9 月 30 日储备报告显示，资产约 1915 亿美元、负债约 1835 亿美元，超额资产约 79.5 亿美元。

标普还指出，Tether 于 2025 年 1 月迁至萨尔瓦多后，当地监管要求 70% 储备可在 30 日内变现，但框架较为宽泛，仍可纳入黄金、比特币和贷款等相对高风险资产，且未要求隔离储备资产。此外，KPMG 虽于 2026 年 8 月确认已对 Tether 2025 年报表出具无保留意见，这是该公司首次「完整独立审计」，但经审计报表和审计师报告尚未公布；储备报告亦未披露托管机构和交易对手，鉴证仍为季度，而其他稳定币普遍按月披露。标普同时提到，USDT 在过去 12 个月保持了较好的价格稳定记录。

知情人士：英伟达董事会仍存3名「保黄派」，已缩小新任CEO考虑范围

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，据 semafor 援引知情人士报道，尽管英伟达宣称不打算让被解职的 CEO 黄仁勋重返，但董事会中的一部分成员正在推动他的回归。

知情人士称，黄仁勋已与多位科技高管会面，并与至少一名董事会成员谈论了他回归的可能性。

与这名董事的对话发生在公司发布财报之前，也发生在黄仁勋周二发表公开声明之前。他在声明中表示，如果董事会认为回归符合「我们股东、员工、公司以及美国的最佳利益」，他愿意回到公司。

几小时后，英伟达董事长哈维·琼斯（Harvey Jones）在公司财报电话会议上表示，这家芯片制造商并未考虑让黄仁勋回归，且董事会已一致投票接受他的辞呈。

黄仁勋和英伟达的发言人拒绝置评。

一些知情人士表示，尽管有三名董事提出反对，但其他董事会成员已开始缩小寻找黄仁勋继任者的范围。

知情人士称，ARM CEO 雷内·哈斯（Rene Haas）和 Marvell CEO 马特·墨菲（Matt Murphy）都在考虑范围之内。其中一位人士透露，哈斯已与至少部分英伟达董事谈论过接任该职位的事宜，但他表示，在有人呼吁让黄仁勋重回掌舵位置的情况下接任该职位，他担心这会带来不好的外界观感。

ARM 和 Marvell 的发言人未立即回应置评请求。此外，鉴于 Marvell 正在处理与竞争对手 Lumentum 的大规模合并事宜，墨菲能否接任英伟达 CEO 一职也尚不清楚。

Kraken母公司Payward达成协议将收购Tribe Capital

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，据 Payward 官方公告，综合金融服务与市场基础设施平台 Payward, Inc. 已签署最终协议，将收购创投及资产管理平台 Tribe Capital Management, Inc.。Tribe Capital 运用人工智能和数据科学，对早期及后期私募投资进行承销与资本配置，管理规模为 27 亿美元。交易财务条款未披露，尚需满足包括必要同意在内的惯例交割条件，预计于 2027 年第一季度完成。

Payward 表示，Tribe Capital 在投资寻源、承销、组合构建和基金管理方面的能力将补充其现有基础设施，并成为其资产管理条线的重要组成部分，该条线与交易、银行、服务及 AI 并列。公司计划在 Tribe Capital 现有投资平台基础上开发新的私募市场产品，并将投资发起、资产管理与托管、交易、抵押及代币化等能力衔接。Tribe Capital 联合创始人 Jonathan Hsu 表示，加入 Payward 使其有机会将 Tribe 的投资方法带入一家全球金融平台，并认为双方在投资方法与 Payward 的基础设施、分发及产品构建能力上契合。

公告还显示，Tribe Capital 成立于 2018 年，由 Arjun Sethi、Jonathan Hsu 和 Ted Maidenberg 创立，总部位于美国加州门洛帕克，通过集合基金和跟投工具投资早期及后期私募公司，投资组合涵盖 Shiprocket、SpaceX、Applied Intuition、Apollo.io 和 Kapital 等。Payward 称，其是 Kraken 以及 NinjaTrader、Breakout、xStocks、CF Benchmarks 等产品背后的基础设施层。本次交易中，Moelis & Company LLC 担任 Payward 的财务顾问，Jones Day 与 Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz 担任法律顾问，Morrison Foerster 担任监管顾问，Ropes & Gray 担任 Tribe Capital 的法律顾问。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Trump administration unveils new center to choke off scam payments
Americans reported more than $17.7 billion in online fraud losses in 2025.
The Trump administration has unveiled a new Threat Disruption Center, aimed at stopping money flows to foreign criminal networks behind scams, cybercrime and sextortion schemes.
The Homeland Security Task Force’s National Coordination Center, co-led by the departments of Homeland Security and Justice, announced the launch of the unit on Wednesday. It seeks to help more than 30 federal agencies and over 440 state and local partners track scams and work with banks and crypto platforms to stop payments to scam networks.
The Homeland Security statement said the center was created under a March 2026 executive order that directed federal agencies to work with private companies to combat online fraud and other cybercrime targeting Americans.
“Every hour between a victim’s report and a response gives criminals more time to launder stolen funds and identify their next target,” said Heith Janke, operations director of the FBI’s Criminal Branch.
Blockchain intelligence firm TRM Labs was selected as the center’s main private-sector partner. It will provide and maintain Ardence, the investigative platform the center will use to map scam networks and identify victims. TRM said it will also provide engineering and investigative support.
“These scammers rarely stop after one payment — they drain a victim’s savings, or their retirement, over months and years,” said Esteban Castano, co-founder and CEO of TRM Labs.
“Stepping in sooner changes everything: a warning before the next payment, a scam website removed before it victimizes another family, or stolen funds frozen while they can still be recovered.
The FBI received about 453,000 reports of online fraud in 2025, with reported losses exceeding $17.7 billion.
In September, the Justice Department estimated that overseas scam centers cost Americans about $10 billion a year through schemes including crypto and online investment fraud.
Related: US authorities dismantle crypto scam network that stole tens of millions
items.title: Trump administration unveils new center to choke off scam payments

BTCPay Server发布紧急更新修复nginx五项安全漏洞

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，据 BTCPay Server 官方消息，该项目正在发布紧急更新，以应对 nginx 相关漏洞 CVE-2026-123007、CVE-2026-123634、CVE-2026-123633、CVE-2026-121810 和 CVE-2026-113425，并建议用户尽快升级。该项目称，此次为依赖项更新，下一版本的 BTCPay 仍在测试中；更新后可用 docker exec nginx nginx -v 核查，预期应显示 nginx/1.31.9。

升级方面，服务器管理员可在 Server Settings → Maintenance 点击 Update；大多数 Docker 部署可通过 SSH 执行 sudo su -，进入 btcpayserver-docker 目录并运行 btcpay-update.sh；Umbrel、Start9 等节点平台用户需待所在平台提供更新后尽快安装。若无法立即升级，核心贡献者 ndeet 提供了面向 Docker 部署的临时、非持久缓解方案：在 nginx 配置中关闭 HTTP/2，再检测配置并重载服务，直至相关 nginx 更新可用。

BTCPay Server 将此次预警归功于 Rob Hamilton、danielabrozzoni 及 Bitcoin Red Team 其余成员对开源生态的监测，并表示目前提及的 nginx 利用方式较为脆弱，迄今尚无公开确认的攻击，但作为开源项目将尽快为用户提供修复方案。

S&P Global Ratings maintained its stablecoin stability assessment of Tether's USDT, the world's largest stablecoin, at 5 (weak), the lowest on its five-point scale. items.content:
花旗、PNC等美国银行更新协议，使用第三方AI代理的客户即便遭黑客攻击也需自行担责

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，据 TechCrunch 报道，美国第三大商业银行花旗银行（Citibank）于本周更新在线用户协议，向使用第三方 AI 工具处理个人财务的客户明确，相关操作一旦出现问题将由客户自行承担，即便遭遇黑客攻击也不例外。

花旗发言人对 TechCrunch 表示，随着第三方 AI 工具日益普及，银行希望客户理解分享银行凭证或授权此类工具访问账户的风险，并强调选择向第三方 AI 代理开放账户访问权限的客户，需对该类代理所进行的活动负责。报道称，花旗此次更新不仅要求客户对 AI 代理的操作负责，还规定一旦 AI 工具泄露凭证或遭到黑客攻击，黑客利用账户实施的行为同样由客户承担责任。美国最大的两家银行摩根大通（JPMorgan）和美国银行（Bank of America）已于上月宣布类似政策；美国第八大银行 PNC 于 18 日更新了相关条款。另据 TechCrunch 所见邮件，大型银行 Citizens 本周也向客户发送邮件，警示其需对 AI 助手的所有操作承担责任。

报道指出，AI 代理可被授予银行及其他在线金融门户的登录凭证，用于分析消费和投资、提供建议，乃至处理交易和账单支付。金融机构表示，不会为自动助手发起的有意或无意交易承担撤销责任。Anthropic 本月早些时候推出的个人理财工具被明确标为「只读」，「不能转移、管理或投资用户的资金」。

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- Japan’s Nov. 18 auction drew competitive tenders worth 3.64 times the amount accepted, down from 5.84 for the same bond in October.
- The dollar-yen midpoint moved just ¥0.01 between the Bank of Japan’s two Tokyo readings, while overnight yen funding held steady.
- Japan’s Nov. 25 bond sale will test long-term demand, while yen funding and futures data matter more directly for Bitcoin leverage.
Demand fell at Japan’s Nov. 18 auction of a 20-year government bond, with investors offering to buy 3.64 times the amount the Finance Ministry accepted in the competitive auction, putting pressure on traders who borrow yen to hold Bitcoin.
The average accepted yield rose, while the yen barely moved between the Bank of Japan’s two 5 p.m. Tokyo readings.
In the Nov. 18 results, the ministry recorded ¥1.914 trillion in competitive tenders for issue 198 and accepted ¥525.8 billion. At the October auction, it received ¥3.139 trillion and accepted ¥537.1 billion.
Demand fell by much more than the amount sold in the competitive auction, and the average accepted yield rose 3.3 basis points to 3.756% from 3.723%.
Competitive coverage fell from 5.84× on Oct. 20 to 3.64× on Nov. 18 for Japan’s 20-year issue 198.
At 5 p.m. in Tokyo, the midpoint of the Bank of Japan’s dollar-yen quote was 159.35 yen per dollar on Nov. 18, up one hundredth of a yen from 159.34 on Nov. 17.
Money-market broker Tokyo Tanshi reported a weighted average unsecured overnight call rate of 1.227%, unchanged from the previous day. The rate measures one-day borrowing in Japan’s call money market, for which the Bank of Japan publishes a daily series.
What would put pressure on Bitcoin positions
A trader borrowing yen short-term to hold Bitcoin faces higher costs to renew the loan if funding rates rise. If the trader sells Bitcoin for dollars and leaves the yen debt unhedged, a stronger yen makes repaying the loan in dollar terms more expensive.
Bank for International Settlements researchers documented that feedback during the August 2024 unwind in leveraged currency and equity trades.
Bitfinex reported that aggregate Bitcoin futures open interest fell to 645,750 BTC over Nov. 14 and 15, 8% below Nov. 11. The futures total shows how much exposure was outstanding but gives no breakdown by funding currency.
BIS research showed that although it identified $271 billion in yen-denominated bank loans to non-bank borrowers outside Japan in the first quarter of 2024, it could not determine how much was used for carry trades.
The Finance Ministry plans to offer about ¥300 billion at the Nov. 25 reopening of a 40-year bond, the next test of long-dated demand.
A stronger signal for Bitcoin would be rising short-term yen borrowing costs or a sustained strengthening of the yen, alongside shrinking futures exposure and evidence that traders cutting positions had yen liabilities.
items.title: Japan bond yields surge to 3.75%, hiding a quiet Bitcoin trap

Anthropic IPO加价又加量：定价83美元，募资813亿美元，打破SpaceX首发纪录

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Anthropic 正式宣布 IPO 定价为每股 83 美元，高于此前 70 至 78 美元的发行区间。公司还将发行规模从原计划的 8.25 亿股扩大至 9.8 亿股，公开发售总额达到约 813 亿美元，超过 SpaceX 今年 6 月创下的 750 亿美元 IPO 首发纪录。

这相当于把此前最高约 644 亿美元的发行规模，一口气提高了约 170 亿美元。按照包含员工期权等潜在股份的口径计算，Anthropic 的估值达到约 1.5 万亿美元。

两周前，还有潜在投资者认为 Anthropic 的估值应该降至约 1 万亿美元。如今需求却远超供应。CNBC 援引知情人士称，机构投资者提交了约 4000 亿美元的认购意向，散户接近 1000 亿美元，合计约为最终发行规模的 6 倍。

不过，813 亿美元并非全部进入 Anthropic。公司实际出售约 9.56 亿股，预计获得约 794 亿美元的发行收入（未扣费用）；另外约 20 亿美元来自七名联合创始人出售股份。

此前披露的 260 亿美元科技巨头私募认购也不包含在这 813 亿美元中。Anthropic 股票预计于 11 月 19 日正式登陆纳斯达克，交易代码为 ANT。

items.content:
谷歌Gemini 4 Neon发布：跑分反超Carbon，排名全球第三

动察 Beating AI 快讯，谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Neon，定位介于旗舰模型 Carbon 和轻量模型 Hydrogen 之间。它主要面向复杂编程、数据分析和长时间运行的 AI Agent，主打接近旗舰的能力和更快的任务处理速度。

独立评测机构 Artificial Analysis 的测试显示，Neon 在最高推理档位下取得 61 分，超过 Carbon 高推理档的 60 分、Claude Opus 5.5 的 59 分和 GPT-6.2 Sol 的 57 分，排名全球第三。

Neon 最明显的优势是速度。在各自最高推理档位下，它完成一项任务平均需要约 21 分钟，Carbon 则需要约 36 分钟，耗时减少约 40%。Neon 的输出速度达到每秒约 110 个 Token，接近 Carbon 的两倍。

编程方面，Neon 在 Terminal-Bench 4.1 上取得 65.2%，与 Opus 5.5 的 65.8% 几乎持平。它还针对 Google Antigravity 做了适配，可以充当总指挥，调度多个 Hydrogen 子智能体并行工作。在 SWE-sweep 测试中，Neon 使用简易智能体框架时得分为 12.8%，换成 Antigravity 框架后达到 39.0%。

Neon 支持 100 万 Token 上下文。API 每百万输入 Token 收费 3 美元，输出 15 美元，比 Claude Opus 5.5 和 Carbon 的原价（4 美元、20 美元）便宜 25%。不过，Carbon 目前还在打五折，因此 Neon 暂时反而更贵。等到 12 月 1 日 Carbon 恢复原价，Neon 才会比它便宜。

Neon 已在 Gemini API、AI Studio、Gemini 应用和 Antigravity 上线。Google AI Pro 和 Ultra 订阅用户均可使用，而 Carbon 在 Gemini 应用和 Antigravity 中仅面向 Ultra 用户开放。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Fed officials saw October rate hold as a ‘close call,’ minutes show
The latest FOMC minutes suggest greater appetite for higher rates than the Fed’s 10–2 vote indicated, with markets now pricing in a December hike.
A few Federal Reserve officials who supported holding interest rates steady in October considered the decision a “close call,” according to minutes released Wednesday, as policymakers signaled that further hikes would likely be needed to bring inflation back to 2%.
The Federal Open Market Committee voted 10–2 in October to keep its benchmark rate at 3.75% to 4%. Fed Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack favored a quarter-point increase. The minutes showed that a few participants who supported holding rates steady still viewed the decision as a “close call.”
“The minutes suggest broader support for an October hike than the 10–2 vote alone implied — and that was before payrolls and CPI both came in hot,” Lewis Huang, an analyst at crypto exchange Bitget, told Cointelegraph.
With markets overwhelmingly expecting a December rate hike, attention is shifting to whether the Fed will raise rates by a quarter or half percentage point.
“With a December hike already fully priced in, the focus shifts to the size of the move and the policy path beyond December,” said Huang.
CME FedWatch has put the odds of a December quarter-point hike at about 90% and a half-point increase at about 10% at the time of writing.
Bitcoin was trading around $62,300 after the minutes were released. Huang said a further rise in Treasury yields and the dollar would add pressure to Bitcoin, which was already trading below its 200-week moving average near $68,000.
“For Bitcoin, a break below the weekend low near $62,000 could extend the sell-off,” Huang said.
Fed officials flag AI inflation and financial stability risks
Fed officials also raised concerns about the inflationary impact of AI investment, with many participants noting that demand for related equipment was straining supply and pushing up consumer technology prices. Several warned that the pressures were spreading beyond industries directly involved in data center construction.
Related: Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December
Officials separately discussed the financial risks if AI investments disappointed.
“Most participants observed that AI-related debt had grown rapidly and that much of this growth had taken place through complex and opaque financing structures,” the minutes show. “A few participants remarked that AI-related exposures were becoming increasingly concentrated among a small number of firms.”
Fabian Dori, chief investment officer at Sygnum Bank, said markets were already pricing in a series of hikes into next year.
“That likely keeps long-term yields and the dollar firm, and the question for Bitcoin is whether debasement concerns and advancing institutional adoption can outweigh it,” Dori said.
Magazine: How to preserve wealth and access funds during a national emergency
items.title: Fed officials saw October rate hold as a ‘close call,’ minutes show

items.content:
富途信托推出数字资产家族信托，综合资产门槛等值300万美元起

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，据美通社报道，富途控股（Nasdaq: FUTU）旗下全资信托机构富途信托宣布推出「数字资产家族信托」，协助香港高净值家庭及家族办公室将主流加密货币与传统金融资产纳入同一信托架构，统筹规划数字财富的持有、托管衔接、日常管理及跨代传承安排。该服务主要面向香港税务居民家庭及家族办公室，信托内综合资产门槛为等值 300 万美元起。

据介绍，该信托围绕两项安排设计。其一为「股币同构」统一治理，客户可将获接纳的比特币（BTC）、以太币（ETH）等主流数字资产，连同港股、美股、ETF 等传统金融资产纳入同一信托架构，并按需衔接香港持牌证券商、银行及持牌虚拟资产交易平台等专业机构。其二为保留投资权、交易与提资分离，在香港法律许可的范围内，客户可通过信托契约设置保留权力或授权机制，继续参与或指示获准范围内的投资决策；但投资交易权与资产提取权严格分离，任何提款或分配均须遵循信托程序。

富途信托行政总裁林伟彬表示，很多客户清楚如何操作数字资产，却未必有机会用家人听得懂的方式完整交代账户、授权与传承意愿，希望通过清晰的持有架构、专业托管与接续机制，为客户与家人预留长远安排。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/378073

特朗普政府成立网络犯罪威胁中心，打击加密货币诈骗等非法活动

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，据彭博社报道，特朗普政府周三宣布成立新的网络犯罪威胁中心（Threat Disruption Center），以打击针对美国民众的加密货币诈骗及其他网络犯罪。该中心将作为国土安全特别工作组的技术资源与协作平台，由 30 多个联邦机构及 440 多个州和地方合作伙伴组成，主要负责处理受害者举报、追踪诈骗资金流向、识别犯罪分子使用的加密钱包及寻找其他潜在受害者。

作为该计划的一部分，美国政府向区块链分析公司 TRM Labs 授予一份为期一年的合同，金额约 9500 万美元，用于提供技术支持，包括作为主要调查工具的 AI 平台。目前已有超过 60 名 TRM 员工参与该项目。TRM Labs CEO Esteban Castaño 表示，政府希望利用 AI 近乎实时地筛查受害者举报，并及时发现有助于追回受害者资金的行动机会。

根据美国联邦调查局（FBI）数据，2025 年网络犯罪造成的损失接近 210 亿美元，同比增长约 25%，其中加密货币相关损失占比超过一半。该合同于今年 7 月以非竞争性方式授予 TRM Labs，其竞争对手 Chainalysis 随后提起诉讼，指控合同授予过程存在不合理之处，但诉讼已于 9 月被驳回。

美联储会议纪要释放明确鹰派信号，几乎所有官员预期后续加息，理事沃勒呼吁考虑12月加息50个基点

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，美联储于凌晨公布的 10 月货币政策会议纪要显示，几乎所有与会官员认为，为确保通胀及时回落至 2% 目标，未来几个月进一步上调联邦基金利率目标区间可能是适宜的。这一表态被市场解读为明显鹰派，进一步巩固了 12 月加息预期。与此同时，美联储理事克里斯托弗·沃勒（Christopher Waller）当天在公开表态中态度更为激进，明确提出可考虑在 12 月一次性加息 50 个基点，或向市场发出更清晰的加速收紧信号。⁠

根据会议纪要，10 月 27 日至 28 日举行的联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）会议最终以 10 票赞成、2 票反对的结果，决定将基准利率维持在 3.75% 至 4% 的区间不变。理事丽莎·库克（Lisa Cook）和克利夫兰联储行长贝丝·哈马克（Beth Hammack）投下反对票，主张当时即加息 25 个基点。纪要指出，支持维持利率不变的官员中，部分人认为这一决定是「险胜」（close call）。与此同时，「几乎所有」与会者判断，根据其对通胀和劳动力市场的基准展望，未来几个月进一步加息「可能是合适的」。少数官员还表示，如果后续通胀数据表现不利，12 月会议甚至可以考虑加息幅度超过 25 个基点。⁠

纪要还显示，人工智能（AI）基础设施建设成为本次会议的重要讨论议题。官员们认为，相关需求可能成为通胀的重要来源，同时也可能带来潜在的金融稳定风险。多数官员强调，当前通胀压力仍然广泛存在，需通过进一步收紧政策加以应对。

在会议纪要公布前后，沃勒于 11 月 18 日接受 CNBC 采访时发表了更为鹰派的看法。他表示自己「非常非常担心通胀」，认为通胀「方向错了，而且正在扩散」，并非仅集中在少数领域。沃勒指出，如果美联储希望真正将通胀拉回目标，就需要采取更积极的行动，要么在 12 月一次性加息 50 个基点，要么明确向市场释放 2027 年将加快加息节奏的信号。他进一步表示，可能需要「给市场一个冲击」（shock people），打破企业和消费者将 3% 左右的通胀视为正常水平的心理预期，否则仅逆转去年的降息可能还不足以实现目标。⁠

市场目前对 12 月加息 25 个基点的预期已非常充分，而对 50 个基点加息的定价仍较低。分析人士认为，本次会议纪要与沃勒的表态叠加，进一步强化了美联储继续收紧的路径，但最终 12 月会议的具体决定仍将取决于后续通胀数据的表现。当前利率水平、AI 相关投资对经济的影响，以及通胀扩散程度，仍是官员们重点关注的变量。

马斯克：中期选举捐款花了这么多钱却没看到什么成效，我觉得自己挺傻的

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，埃隆·马斯克通过视频连线出席在纽约举行的《纽约时报》DealBook 峰会，当时他在中国。在与《纽约时报》安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金对谈时，马斯克谈到本轮美国中期选举捐款时说：「花了这么多钱却没看到什么成效，我觉得自己挺傻的，又或者，如果没有这笔投入，情况可能会更糟。」他表示，如果能让时间倒流，自己会少花一些钱，「这当然表明，美国选举并不只取决于金钱。显然，你可以把很多钱投入选举，但效果相对有限，我认为这次就是如此。」

据竞选资金监督机构 OpenSecrets 统计，马斯克在 2026 年中期选举中向共和党候选人、政治行动委员会及外部团体捐赠超过 4.45 亿美元。此次中期选举中，民主党获得国会参众两院控制权。马斯克还称，「我不是 MAGA」，并表示至少自己不确定 MAGA 意味着什么，也没有对共和党一套政策的盲目遵从；他同时说，「我也不赞成共和党占据超级多数，我们还是希望有一些制衡。」

Anthropic IPO信息速览：定价83美元高于指导区间，总募资超千亿美元成史上最大IPO

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，人工智能公司 Anthropic（Claude 母公司）已完成首次公开募股（IPO）定价。本次 IPO 将发行价定在每股 83 美元，高于此前设定的 70–78 美元区间。同时，公司扩大发行规模，最终出售约 9.8 亿股，合计募资约 813 亿美元，一举超过 SpaceX 今年 6 月的纪录，成为历史上规模最大的 IPO 之一。

除公开募集外，Google、Nvidia、Microsoft、AMD 等科技巨头还将以相同价格通过私募方式认购约 260 亿美元股份（主要为无投票权类别），进一步强化其在 AI 生态中的布局。

Anthropic 的市值将取决于总流通股数，但这一股价将使其估值超过此前 1.4 万亿美元的目标。该股预计将于周四在纳斯达克开始交易，股票代码为「ANT」。

此次上市是对 AI 行业的一次重大考验，该行业近期经历了一系列冲击，包括在中期选举投票中感受到的剧烈反弹，以及上周英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋的离职。市场本就因担忧利率上升将使许多数据中心开发商和新型云服务商（neoclouds）的债务变得难以承受而紧张不安。

根据招股说明书，截至 9 月 30 日的九个月内，Anthropic 表示其营收为 332.4 亿美元，较去年同期增长约 1200%。该公司报告称，该九个月期间净亏损 1040 亿美元，但其中大部分是由于可转换票据和衍生负债的公允价值变动。文件显示，Anthropic 在 2025 年同期亏损 251 亿美元。

Anthropic 在一份修订文件中表示，截至 10 月底，其年化营收约为 810 亿美元，较上月增加 100 亿美元。

56%英伟达员工盼黄仁勋回归，副总裁巴克在继任候选人中支持度最高

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，据韩联社报道，职场社区 Blind 利用其对话式人工智能服务 Blind Claire，对美国时间 11 月 12 日至 16 日期间 531 名美国英伟达在职员工在公开频道发布的 627 条相关帖子进行分析。结果显示，认为黄仁勋应当回归的意见占 56%，比例最高；若回归难以实现，24% 的意见主张提拔能够延续其商业愿景的内部高管，20% 主张引入外部人士。

在继任候选人的相对支持度上，若将黄仁勋的支持度设为 100，英伟达副总裁伊恩·巴克为 27，在候选人群中居首；曾任职英伟达的 Arm 首席执行官雷内·哈斯为 4.5，现任临时首席执行官、首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯为 4.0，黄仁勋长女麦迪逊·黄为 2.5。以人物正面提及比例计，黄仁勋为 72%，巴克为 60%，哈斯为 43%，克雷斯为 21%。巴克已在英伟达工作逾 20 年，主导过 GPU 计算平台 CUDA 的开发，并出席了英伟达三季度业绩电话会，但未直接回答分析师提问。

Blind 数据分析师表示，英伟达在职员工对首席执行官候选人的支持与对其个人能力的评价密切关联，要求重新任用黄仁勋的舆论，也源于认为无人能够替代其能力的不安。

items.content:
Anthropic期权最快下周一挂牌，市场预计投资者需求旺盛

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，Anthropic 股票期权最早可能于周一开始交易。芝加哥期权交易所全球市场公司（Cboe Global Markets）预计，将在 Anthropic 股票开始交易两个交易日后挂牌相关期权合约，具体时间取决于行业准备情况。

Cboe 全球衍生品业务主管罗布·霍金表示：「Anthropic 的 IPO 可能成为又一个催化剂，为期权市场带来新一轮投资者和交易活动。」Anthropic 预计将于周三晚些时候确定 IPO 发行价，股票将于周四在纳斯达克开始交易。

Capital Market Laboratories 首席执行官奥菲尔·戈特利布表示，Anthropic 期权的市场关注度可能超过今年早些时候 SpaceX 期权推出时的水平。Anthropic IPO 认购超额倍数较高，正推动公司估值上升；交易前市场可能出现各种头寸布局，加之当前市场环境，也将推高期权需求。

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，据美联储公布的 10 月 27 日至 28 日货币政策会议纪要，联邦公开市场委员会以 10 票赞成、2 票反对，决定将联邦基金利率目标区间维持在 3.75% 至 4%。投票反对的委员为丽莎·库克和贝丝·哈马克，两人主张在此次会议上将利率目标区间上调 25 个基点。

会议纪要显示，在未来数月的政策前景上，几乎所有与会者认为，基于其对通胀和劳动力市场的基线展望，进一步上调联邦基金利率目标区间可能是合适的，这与 9 月经济预测摘要大体一致，目的是确保通胀及时回到 2% 的目标。两名与会者指出，如果后续通胀数据表现不佳，下次会议或可考虑加息超过 25 个基点。另有少数与会者表示，通胀可能比预期更为持久，届时或有必要转向更加紧缩的政策立场。部分与会者主张在 10 月会议上加息 25 个基点，认为当前政策立场不够紧缩；其中少数人警告，进一步推迟加息可能使高通胀趋于固化，或迫使日后采取更大幅度、更具干扰性的紧缩。

多数与会者支持此次维持利率不变，认为积累更多信息有助于确定适合的政策立场。其中少数人在支持维持利率的同时表示，这一决定较为艰难。许多与会者强调，应明确传达维持利率目标区间的决定并不意味着委员会削弱了及时将通胀恢复至 2% 的承诺。与会者表示，未来政策决定将取决于后续数据、前景变化及风险平衡。委员会同意下次会议于 12 月 8 日至 9 日举行。

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- Bitwise sold 23.7 million XRP to fund third-quarter cash redemptions as its holdings grew by 126.3 million XRP.
- Franklin received 41.3 million XRP in kind and bought 26.6 million for creations, with zero third-quarter redemptions.
- The Nov. 17 ETF outflow estimates measure net withdrawals and leave the amount of XRP sold that day unresolved.
Bitwise’s quarterly filings show its XRP ETF sold 23.7 million XRP to meet cash redemptions from July through September 2026, even as the fund increased its holdings by 126.3 million XRP.
The quarter’s redemption sales slightly exceeded the 22.9 million XRP the fund sold for the same purpose in the entire first half of the year.
Bitwise’s holdings climbed from 286.8 million XRP at the end of June to 413.1 million at the end of September. The Sept. 30 quarterly report, filed Nov. 6, records both the XRP the fund sold for redemptions and the larger amount it added for new shares.
Subtracting the six-month XRP schedule from the nine-month schedule isolates what happened in the third quarter. Bitwise bought 87.9 million tokens to back newly issued shares and received another 62.3 million XRP in kind.
Together, those flows added 150.2 million tokens before the fund’s cash redemption sales and roughly 241,383 XRP transferred to pay sponsor fees. Bitwise reported zero in-kind redemptions for the quarter.
Bitwise created 13.75 million shares and redeemed 2.42 million, leaving a net increase of 11.33 million shares, an increase in shares that masks the gross redemptions that took place along the way.
The sponsor arranges a sale of the underlying XRP for a cash redemption and pays out the proceeds, less a transaction fee. In-kind redemption delivers the token itself to the authorized firm or its designee.
The Franklin Templeton XRP ETF’s third-quarter filing shows the firm issued 6.25 million shares in the quarter, including 3.8 million in kind and 2.45 million for cash. The fund received 41.3 million tokens in kind and bought 26.6 million for creations, and recorded zero share redemptions.
A separate Canary XRP ETF filing puts that fund’s cash redemption sales at 9.55 million XRP for the nine months through Sept. 30. Canary reported zero tokens delivered for in-kind redemptions over those nine months.
What Nov. 17 XRP outflows leave unresolved
In its Nov. 18 update, Crypto ETF’s fund table estimated $6.1 million in net outflows for Nov. 17 based on three of five tracked funds.
Alpha Finance’s daily figures also put the rounded net outflow at $6.1 million, with data for all five funds it tracks. Alpha Finance estimated $5 million in outflows from Canary and $1.1 million from Grayscale, compared with $4.9 million and $1.2 million in the Crypto ETF snapshot.
Canary’s daily share history shows 490,000 fewer shares outstanding on Nov. 17 than on Nov. 16. Bitwise’s fund data showed 36.44 million shares on Nov. 16 and 406.8 million XRP in its Nov. 17 holdings table.
If issuers break out the same categories in their next filings, it will be possible to measure sales for fourth-quarter redemptions and distinguish them from in-kind transfers and fees.
items.title: Bitwise offloads 23.7M XRP while silently stacking 126M more

items.author: Oluwapelumi Adejumo
items.content:
Quick Take
- Michael Saylor's STRC fell to its lowest level since August despite Strategy spending $2.7 billion on buybacks.
- Strategy spent $1.4 billion buying STRC near $100, yet shares have plunged toward $95, pushing the annualized yield to roughly 12.5%.
- With just $332 million in buyback capacity left, Strategy faces questions over further repurchases as Peter Schiff warns of potential Bitcoin sales.
Strategy's (formerly MicroStrategy) STRC preferred stock plunged to its lowest level since August on Wednesday despite the company's multibillion-dollar repurchase campaign.
The Michael Saylor-led company's preferred shares fell to $95.51 before recovering to $96.16, according to Strategy's data. The decline left STRC roughly 4% below its $100 stated amount, pushing its annualized yield to approximately 12.5%.
Regular-session, unadjusted daily closes through Nov. 17. Nov. 18 is an incomplete trading day: final $97.00 point is a timestamped 12:39 p.m. ET intraday quote. The $100 series is STRC stated amount, and displayed prices are verified against Stock Analysis.
The selloff comes despite Strategy spending about $2.67 billion repurchasing STRC shares since July to stabilize the security near $100.
An earlier analysis found that the company spent about $1.4 billion on repurchases between Sept. 28 and Nov. 15, with weekly average purchase prices ranging from $99.06 to $99.93.
That accounted for more than half of its total repurchase spending, even as the discount to STRC's stated amount had nearly disappeared.
Open $98.50, high $98.69, low $95.50, latest available quote $97.00 at 12:39 p.m. ET. Bars are dollars below STRC’s $100 stated amount, and negative numbers are discounts.
This sustained intervention has left just $332.2 million available under its $3 billion preferred-stock repurchase authorization, raising questions about how much more capital Strategy will commit if selling pressure persists.
Strategy CEO defends STRC's dividend coverage
Despite the renewed weakness, Strategy CEO Phong Le has defended STRC's financial structure and its ability to generate income for investors.
In a Nov. 17 statement, Le said:
“STRC is Digital Credit: high income, low volatility, and 44 years of dividend coverage. Built for income investors as TradFi and DeFi converge.”
His assessment contrasts with economist Peter Schiff, who warned that the security's continued decline could eventually force Strategy to sell Bitcoin.
Schiff said:
“Despite the buybacks, $STRC is collapsing. At $96 the current yield is 12.5% and rising.”
Schiff argued that Strategy would have to exhaust its cash reserves to support the stock before selling Bitcoin to finance additional repurchases. He suggested raising or suspending dividends as an alternative.
However, Le's 44-year coverage assertion reflects Strategy's broader Bitcoin-backed financial capacity.
The company's latest disclosures showed that its $4.75 billion dedicated dollar reserve and $151.2 million in unrestricted cash provide approximately 3.4 years of coverage for preferred dividends and debt-interest obligations.
Strategy also held 850,849 BTC as of Nov. 15, providing another source of liquidity through potential asset sales.
The company has already authorized Bitcoin sales to support its preferred-stock obligations and repurchase programs, although it has recently relied more heavily on common-stock issuance.
items.title: Strategy’s STRC stock crashes to $95 despite promise of 44 years of dividends

items.author: Decrypt Staff
items.content:
In brief
- Ledger confirmed tampered hardware wallets in Berlin, is investigating two suspected units in Dubai, and found one affected Nano Gen5 in Southeast Asia, calling it “the same incident.”
- Every confirmed device carries the same modification designed to capture recovery phrases. Ledger says there’s no flaw in its chip or operating system, and no confirmed case from ledger.com.
- Ledger expects more devices to surface. It’s urging affected buyers to move funds to new wallets and is offering X-ray inspections at its factory in France.
The tampered Ledger wallets aren’t just a Southeast Asia problem anymore.
Ledger said Wednesday it has confirmed tampered hardware wallets in Berlin and is investigating reports of two more in Dubai, expanding a probe it had previously described as a localized incident in Southeast Asia.
“Our findings since then show tampered devices outside Southeast Asia. It is the same incident,” the company said in an update on its support site.
The investigation began last month after customers who bought devices from reseller CryptoBilis reported losses. Onchain investigators traced a suspected drain of about $87 million from hundreds of victim wallets across Ethereum, Tron, and Bitcoin.
Ledger said at the time that all confirmed cases were tied to CryptoBilis, and it later asked resellers in seven Asian markets to pull devices from sale.
Every device Ledger has confirmed shows the same kind of physical modification, designed to capture a user’s recovery phrase during setup. A recovery phrase, typically a string of 24 words, is the master key to a crypto wallet: anyone who has it can drain the funds.
Our investigation into the hardware implant incident we disclosed Oct 15th is ongoing, and we published an update: https://t.co/wx6mfQPr99
There is no flaw in Ledger's secure chip or operating system, and no confirmed case involving a device bought on https://t.co/vQ4QWa1D0f
We…
— Ledger (@Ledger) November 18, 2026
Ledger maintains there’s no flaw in its secure chip or operating system and no confirmed case involving a device bought on ledger.com.
In Germany, Ledger said a few tampered units were localized to Berlin, and it urged anyone who bought a Ledger device there since January 2026 to contact support.
In Dubai, it’s working with distribution partners to learn how two suspected units entered circulation. Those devices were bought at a Virgin Megastore location, according to multiple reports. Ledger also found one affected Nano Gen5 among the Southeast Asian resellers it previously paused.
The company expects more tampered devices to surface, though it says the number remains small overall. Its Donjon security team is examining suspected devices, and Ledger has asked resellers to pause sales wherever inspections are ongoing.
Customers worried about a device should stop using it, Ledger said. It advises moving funds to a new wallet created on a device bought directly from ledger.com, without reusing the old recovery phrase or passphrase, since a tampered device can capture both. It also recommends filing a report with local authorities.
For a limited time, Ledger is offering physical inspections, including X-rays, at its factory in Vierzon, France.
“We will never ask for your recovery phrase,” the company said on X.
The last few months have been a rough stretch for hardware wallet markers overall. Rival manufacturer Trezor said this week that hackers who breached a third-party shipping partner likely took information tied to about 27,000 orders. That’s the company’s third such breach in as many months.

items.author: Cointelegraph by Bryan O'Shea
items.content:
Here’s what happened in crypto today
Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
Today in crypto, Binance said it secured a $6.5 billion worldwide freezing injunction from the Abu Dhabi Global Market Courts to help it recover assets stolen in its recent hack, tokenized Nvidia’s market cap surged 159% as the chipmaker’s stock sank, and reports of cryptocurrency theft involving tampered Ledger hardware wallets have emerged in Dubai.
Binance says it obtained $6.5 billion worldwide freezing order after hack
Binance said it has secured a $6.5 billion worldwide freezing injunction from the Abu Dhabi Global Market Courts as it seeks to recover assets stolen in its record Oct. 29 hack.
The court orders target unidentified perpetrators of the attack and are intended to help issuers, exchanges and other partners freeze and return stolen assets, the company said in a statement shared with Cointelegraph on Wednesday.
The orders can be served via blockchain, according to M. Kendall Day of Gibson Dunn, which represents Binance. This allows legal notices to be delivered to wallet addresses rather than through traditional channels. Day said market participants would also be notified of updates to a “living list” of 26,000 wallet addresses identified as holding stolen assets.
Binance said some businesses require formal court orders before they can release, transfer or return frozen funds. The injunction’s $6.5 billion amount is not a tally of recovered assets, and the statement did not disclose how much had so far been returned under the orders.
Binance also said it obtained orders requiring stolen assets to be handed over. Separate interim orders cover assets frozen by certain named parties against whom no wrongdoing is alleged.
Tokenized Nvidia market cap surges 159% amid Jensen Huang’s exit
The combined market value of tokenized stocks tied to Nvidia shares rose about 159% from Nov. 8 to Tuesday, while the chipmaker’s Nasdaq-listed shares fell nearly 17% from their last close before co-founder Jensen Huang publicly admitted to an extramarital affair.
The value of Nvidia (NVDA) tokens tracked by Token Terminal rose from $155 million on Nov. 8 to $401.9 million by Tuesday.
Nvidia shed about $750 billion in market value, falling from $4.5 trillion at the Nov. 6 close to $3.75 trillion at Tuesday’s close, according to Yahoo Finance data.
Huang acknowledged the affair in a message to Nvidia employees on Nov. 8, nearly two weeks after The New York Times reported that US intelligence officials suspected Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang of spying for Beijing. China denied the allegations.
Tokenized stocks are blockchain tokens designed to track the price of a share. In one common setup, an issuer creates tokens backed by shares held by a custodian.
Binance, for example, lists an Nvidia token that can trade when Nasdaq is closed. It gives investors exposure to Nvidia’s share price without shareholder rights. The market value can rise as more tokens enter circulation, even if Nvidia’s share price falls.
Ledger hardware implant saga reaches Dubai’s Virgin Megastore
Two Ledger owners have reported cryptocurrency thefts involving hardware wallets they say were purchased from an authorized retailer in Dubai, raising concerns that a hardware wallet tampering campaign had also spread to the UAE.
An X user posting as Rewinsky on Monday said they found their Ledger Flex had been tampered with after reporting the loss of about 1,300 Solana (SOL) Mark Karpelès’ Ledger Implant OSINT registry subsequently confirmed the device as containing a hardware implant.
A second owner, posting as New Babylon Order Worldwide, said Tuesday that 507,000 USDt (USDT) was stolen from their Ledger Stax on Saturday. They said the device was bought new at Virgin Megastore Dubai on Oct. 11, two days after Ledger publicly disclosed an investigation into crypto losses involving devices sold by Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis.
The reports suggest the Ledger device tampering has extended past retailers in just Asia and Europe. Ledger lists Virgin Megastores among its authorized retailers in the United Arab Emirates.

items.author: Oluwapelumi Adejumo
items.content:
Quick Take
- Coinbase's AI defenses blocked $4.7 million, or 91%, of attempted crypto transfers tied to an Elon Musk deepfake giveaway scam.
- The system stopped a customer's $100,000 payment, but the same user later bypassed its protection with a false explanation for a $5,000 transfer.
- The incident exposes a weakness in AI fraud prevention as exchanges struggle to protect customers who insist on sending money despite scam warnings.
Coinbase said its AI defenses blocked $4.7 million in attempted cryptocurrency transfers tied to an Elon Musk deepfake scam.
The crypto exchange said on Nov. 17 that its automated fraud-prevention system stopped about 91% of the money customers tried to send to scammers promoting a fake Tesla cryptocurrency giveaway.
The fraudsters had created a lookalike YouTube livestream during a Tesla demonstration, using an AI-generated impersonation of Musk to promise viewers twice the cryptocurrency they deposited into designated wallets.
More than 500,000 people watched the fraudulent broadcast, while hundreds of Coinbase customers attempted to transfer millions of dollars within roughly two hours.
Unlike conventional account compromises, the customers were willingly authorizing the transactions, believing they were participating in a legitimate promotion.
Coinbase said its AI system intercepted suspicious payments in real time, engaging customers before their funds could leave the platform without requiring human intervention.
Coinbase AI stops $100,000 transfer but misses customer's second attempt
Despite preventing most attempted transfers, Coinbase disclosed an incident that illustrates the difficulty of protecting customers determined to complete suspicious payments.
Will Megson, Coinbase's vice president of product working on risk, revealed that one customer initially attempted to transfer $100,000 to the scammers.
The exchange's AI agent identified the suspicious transaction, explained the fraudulent giveaway and convinced the customer to abandon the payment.
However, the customer subsequently returned and attempted another transfer, this time for $5,000.
When questioned about the transaction, the customer falsely claimed the funds were intended for their daughter. The AI accepted the explanation and allowed the payment to proceed.
Megson acknowledged how difficult it is to distinguish legitimate payments from fraudulent transactions when customers provide misleading explanations.
The episode highlights a limitation of automated fraud detection: even when an exchange correctly identifies a scam, customers can still circumvent protections by changing their transaction details or misrepresenting their intentions.
Coinbase's system combines machine-learning models that identify suspicious transactions with an AI agent that examines the payment's context and questions customers about potential fraud.
The agent also assigns each response a confidence score before it reaches the customer.
The exchange said the system had not previously encountered the specific combination of a deepfake giveaway and a live product demonstration, but recognized familiar warning signs, including promises of guaranteed returns and irreversible payments.
Meanwhile, Coinbase said it is expanding its AI-powered fraud prevention efforts through improved detection models, automated reviews of suspicious transactions and faster identification of emerging scam techniques.
items.title: Coinbase AI blocks $4.7 million scam, but a simple lie exposes its weakness
